name: DeepSeek
billing: API calls use your API platform balance and model-specific rates. An empty balance is a separate failure from an invalid API key; review the platform billing before sending a request.

steps.title: Sign in to the API platform
steps.body: Use the API key link in DeepSeek’s official first-call guide to create or sign in to your platform account.

steps.title: Create an API key
steps.body: Create a key for your application in the platform, and keep the full key in your own secret storage.

steps.title: Check balance and model access
steps.body: Review your API balance, limits and currently supported model identifiers before configuring your local application.
